scope: Physical stair-locomotion sound: impact noise plus motor, joint, transmission and structural noise

search_method: OpenAlex discovery; primary arXiv/PMC/publisher/institutional full text; Crossref/OpenAlex venue checks
reading_scope: Targeted reading of methods, experiments and limitations; not a systematic or exhaustive review
changes: Documentation only; no new training, controller changes or robot acoustic measurements

sources.title: Learning Quiet Walking for a Small Home Robot
sources.evidence: Real aibo audio plus simulation contact-velocity metrics; not calibrated dBA comparable to other papers
sources.m20_caveat: Strong penalties caused nonwalking; quietest controller lost some robustness; variable PD changes deployment contract

sources.title: Minimizing Acoustic Noise: Enhancing Quiet Locomotion for Quadruped Robots in Indoor Applications
sources.evidence: Go1 onboard sound-level measurements on indoor flat surfaces, including actual-speed comparison
sources.m20_caveat: Quiet factor weakens velocity reward; not matched M20 wheeled stair validation

sources.title: Human-Centered Development of Guide Dog Robots: Quiet and Stable Locomotion Control
sources.evidence: Go1 flat walking audio comparison and stair demonstrations; approx. 10 dB pertains to walking comparison
sources.m20_caveat: Approximately 12.7–13 cm rise and 60 cm tread differ from M20; smartphone ear-level measurement

sources.title: TACET: Context-Appropriate Acoustic-Social Navigation for Quadrupeds
sources.evidence: Go2 flat acoustic benchmark at matched actual speeds; context-conditioned navigation
sources.m20_caveat: No matched wheeled stair evaluation; novelty and gains are author-reported preprint results

sources.title: Regularizing Action Policies for Smooth Control with Reinforcement Learning
sources.evidence: Policy smoothness, quadrotor control and power; not stair acoustics
sources.m20_caveat: Regularization can suppress required rapid actions; no M20 acoustic claim

sources.title: Gradient-based Regularization for Action Smoothness in Robotic Control with Reinforcement Learning
sources.m20_caveat: No acoustic measurement; M20 already has a second-order action cost

sources.title: Benchmarking Smoothness and Reducing High-Frequency Oscillations in Continuous Control Policies
sources.evidence: Smoothness/task benchmarks including quadruped hardware, without a dBA result
sources.m20_caveat: 26.8% smoothness improvement is not noise reduction in dB

sources.title: Learning Smooth Humanoid Locomotion through Lipschitz-Constrained Policies
sources.evidence: Multi-humanoid sim-to-sim and real motion smoothness
sources.m20_caveat: No acoustic data; Isaac Gym code requires adaptation to this repository

sources.title: Redesigning Regularization for Effective Policy Smoothing
sources.status: published; arXiv v2 states accepted October 8, 2026
sources.evidence: L2C2-v2 benchmarks and real Go2 command transitions using modified RSL-RL; no audio
sources.m20_caveat: Early tracking degradation and tuning tradeoff remain; not a quiet stair result

sources.title: Smoothness as a Constraint for Stable Humanoid Locomotion
sources.evidence: Humanoid grouped constraints and IMU/motion experiments; no acoustic result
sources.m20_caveat: Uses termination-probability-adjusted returns; do not assume it preserves stair exploration

sources.title: Noise in Electric Motors: A Comprehensive Review
sources.evidence: Review of acoustic sources, PWM, electromagnetic forces, structure and measurement
sources.m20_caveat: Not a M20 motor specification; policy smoothing cannot remove every electrical or mechanical source

sources.title: Noise and Vibration Modeling of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors: A Review
sources.status: published review; institutional accepted author manuscript read
sources.evidence: Electromagnetic excitation, structural response and acoustic radiation modelling review
sources.m20_caveat: Automotive PMSM context; M20 motor and drive architecture not established

sources.title: Compact Gearboxes for Modern Robotics: A Review
sources.evidence: Robot transmission mechanisms, nonlinearities and discussion of missing noise benchmarks
sources.m20_caveat: Authors excluded noise from quantitative comparison; cannot rank gearbox noise using this review

exclusions.title: Acoustic Noise of Brushless DC Motors Induced by Electromagnetic Torque Ripple
exclusions.reason: Metadata discovered but full-text retrieval failed; not counted among read sources or used for result claims
